Docs.summary: Compares two decoded images, bitmaps, or pixmaps after normalization to tightly packed BGRA8888.
Docs.remarks: Inputs and optional tolerance and ignore masks are borrowed for a synchronous call; do not mutate or dispose them concurrently. Results retain no native inputs. Difference images are independent, caller-owned, and must be disposed.

Docs.summary: Creates a caller-owned opaque difference image in the selected style, using snapshotted options and optional borrowed tolerance and ignore masks.
Docs.remarks: The default ThresholdOverlay flattens the second (actual) input onto white, then blends red mismatch, amber (255,200,0) tolerated selected-channel difference, or gray (128,128,128) ignored highlights at 50%, rounding half-channel values upward. Exact selected-channel matches retain the flattened actual RGB, including disabled channels. ThresholdMap instead uses opaque red, amber, dimmed actual RGB, and gray classifications. Ignored pixels are black in BinaryMask and ChannelDifference. All styles output BGRA8888 with alpha 255.
Docs.exception: An input is null.
An input or mask is empty or disposed, all channels are disabled, or IgnoreMask excludes every pixel (parameter IgnoreMask).
The dimensions differ or pixel readback fails.
The style, alpha type, or budget is invalid.
